quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.title: Above the Clouds
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.summar: The moon's lid is gone. The pilgrim is coming down from above the sky.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.done: The bell of the pilgrim gate rang. A road goes on beyond the clouds.
The moon's core stopped, yet the moon did not stop falling, and a winged shadow crossed it. The counting song must go on. Ask the storyteller.
Ask the storyteller about the song
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.ascend: The seventh verse is a song of the sky above. Touch the gate atop the bell tower. The sleeping titans are awake.
Touch the gate atop the great bell tower
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.bell.j: The titans carried you above the clouds. Under the broken pilgrim gate, a single bell remains.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.bell.b: Ring the bell of the pilgrim gate
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse:
...Did you hear it? That sound of wings.
The counting song's seventh verse. The last one. Even my grandmother sang this part quietly.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse2:
"Seventh: open your eyes, and choose of the two."
Open your eyes and choose one of two, it says. It never sings what you choose.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse3: Go to the gate atop the bell tower. ...The great ones who slept have been looking at the sky since last night. They're waiting for you, I'd say.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.fell: You nearly fell beneath the clouds, and found yourself back on the island.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.gate: The bell's sound carried far across the sea of clouds.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.arrive.title: The Cloud Sea
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.title: The Isle of Bells
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.summary: A fragment of the former city floats above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.done: The bellkeeper's shadow returned to the sound of the bell.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.walk.jou: From the north of the pilgrim gate's isle, a white bridge climbs above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.jo: A street you know. The former city. Three bells remain on the fragments around it. When a bell rings, the nearby clouds turn solid.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.w: Ring the bell on the west fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.e: Ring the bell on the east fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.n: Ring the bell on the northwest fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.door.jou: Three bells have rung. The door of the broken bell tower in the north answered with a dull toll.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.lord.jou: Someone stands atop the bell tower, carrying a bell.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.lord.lor: Lay the last bellkeeper to rest
message.skyabyss.isle1.bell.w: The bell at the ruined chapel rang.
message.skyabyss.isle1.door.shut: The door won't move. The bells on the fragments have not rung yet.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.w: Someone's last words remained at the ruined chapel.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.e: Someone's last words remained at the market stall.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.n: Someone's last words remained by the well.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_1.title: The Chapel Apprentice
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_1.body:
On the morning the sky turned white, the apprentice kept ringing the bell. The master said, "No one will come, however you ring."

The apprentice did not stop. Not for anyone coming, but to tell the sky that a city had been here.

Even when the clouds rose to their feet, the bell's sound hardened the clouds and kept the apprentice standing to the end.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_2.title: The Market Seller
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_2.body:
The market seller opened the stall on the last day too, not knowing what to sell to what came down from the sky.

"I feel there was a morning like this before," a customer said. The seller laughed and handed over an apple at the usual price.

The last line of the ledger is blank. The sky came before it could be written.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_3.title: The Well Keeper
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_3.body:
The well keeper looked up at the sky with the bucket still lowered, and saw the shadow of wings pass over the clouds.

"The bellkeeper climbed the tower with the bell on his back. He never came down."

There is still water at the bottom of the well, though no one draws it.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_silence: The bellkeeper raises a hand to its mask, and the bells fall silent; the cloud ring unravels. Ring the small bells around you to firm it again.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_wave: The bell wave caught your feet. Jump as the ring passes.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_crumble: Half the floor crumbles into cloud.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_down: The last bellkeeper's great bell slowly falls silent. Every bell on the island answers it, once.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.title: Isle of the Lamp
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.summary: From atop the bell tower, a bridge of light runs down to the next isle.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.done: The lamp-keeper's eye has closed. The lamp is only a lamp again.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.walk.jou: A bridge of pale gold light runs down from the north edge of the bell tower, toward an isle of sand with a leaning lighthouse.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.lamps.jo: The lighthouse beam sweeps the isle. Caught in it, your body grows heavy; rocks and walls hide you. Three dead fishing lamps stand at the ends of the jetties.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.door.jou: The three lamps are lit. The lighthouse door unlatches with a click.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.lord.jou: Atop the lighthouse, an eye in a cage is watching you.
message.skyabyss.isle2.caught: The beam has found you. Your body is heavy. Get behind a rock or a wall.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lamp.w: The west jetty lamp is lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lamp.e: The east jetty lamp is lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lamp.s: The southeast jetty lamp is lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.door.shut: The door will not open. The jetty lamps are not yet lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.echo.w: At the foot of the west jetty, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle2.echo.e: At the foot of the east jetty, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle2.echo.s: At the foot of the southeast jetty, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle2.netted: A wet net has you tangled. When a net caster swings its net, get out of the fan.
message.skyabyss.isle2.marked: The moth's light clings to you. For a while, the beam will find you even in shadow.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lord_stare: The eye's light pierced you. When the thread narrows, get behind a pillar.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lord_down: The eye in the cage slowly closes. The light that swept the isle turns, at last, out to sea.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.bridge_shut: The light bridge will not carry you yet. Calm this isle's lord first.
area.skyabyss.finale_lamp_arena.sub: Where it watched a sea no one returned from
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_1.title: The Net-Master's Daughter
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_1.body:
On the morning no boat came home, the daughter looked up at the lighthouse from the shore.

The lamp was not lighting the sea. It was lighting the sky. Only the lighthouse watched the sea rise into it.

"Is Father's boat up there too?" She folded the nets and walked toward the turning light.
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_2.title: The Lamp-Keeper's Apprentice
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_2.body:
My master said: "A lamp is for watching. If you keep watching, someone comes home."

Even as the shore was lifted into the sky, he would not leave the lamp room. Close your eyes, he said, and the way home disappears.

The last time I saw him, his eye was the color of the lamp. It has not closed since.
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_3.title: The Child at Hide-and-Seek
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_3.body:
Caught by the lamp, you're it. The shore children played at fleeing the turning light into the shadows of the rocks.

That day the light turned slower than usual. The grown-ups were all looking at the sky, and no one took a turn as it.

The child waited behind the rock a long time. "Ready." No one has answered yet.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.title: Isle of the Forge
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.summary: From atop the lighthouse, a bridge of light runs down to an isle of ash.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.done: The rewinder's wheel has stopped. The forge fire moves forward again.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.walk.jo: A bridge of light runs down from the lighthouse to an ash-grey isle. A great forge sends up smoke.
On this isle, what happens happens again. The broken bridges rewind and return for a moment. Where a blow lands, it lands again a little later. Three cold forges wait on the fragments.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.door.jo: The three forges burn. The heat loosens the bar on the great forge's door.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.lord.jo: Atop the great forge, a smith with a wheel on his back strikes the same blow again and again.
message.skyabyss.isle3.door.shut: The door is cold and will not move. The fragments' forges are not yet lit.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo.w: In the bellows yard, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo.e: In the casting yard, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo.n: In the coal yard, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo_first: Embers linger where the blow fell. The same spot will be struck again in a moment. Move away.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_prints: Ember marks glow under your feet. Where you stand will burn. Move.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_ring: The outer ring crumbles and begins to rewind. When the ember outline glows, the stone returns.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_twice: The wheel spins faster. Every blow now comes back twice.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_down: The rewinder's wheel stops and the embers in its cracks go out. For the first time, the great forge burns forward.
area.skyabyss.finale_forge_arena.sub: Where the same blow falls again
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_1.title: The Bellows Boy
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_1.body:
Push the bellows and the forge breathes. Stop and it stops. That was all the boy was taught.

The day the sky drew near, the grown-ups stopped and looked up. Only the boy kept pushing. He felt that if he stopped, everything would.

You can still hear it. Push, draw back, push again.
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_2.title: The Mold-Maker
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_2.body:
Iron poured into a mold sets only as the mold allows. So you carve the mold as the inside-out of what you want.

In her last mold, the mold-maker carved nothing. "Let the people of the next world pour in what shape they like."

The empty mold is still buried in the sand.
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_3.title: The Master Smith's Note
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_3.body:
A botched blow can be struck again. While the iron is hot, it always comes back. That is what I taught my apprentices.

But this time the botch is the world itself. I will strike it again. As many times as it takes, from the same place.

...If I find I cannot stop striking it again, someone, stop me.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past1.fin_p: ...We meet again. We should have dissolved into light before the core, yet this camp alone remembered us.

This is where the four of us sat on that last night. The final campfire before the moon fell.
...The Pilgrim's plume has come down ahead of it. Atop the moon-viewing rock to the north.

I will raise my lamp. Inside the circle around me, wind and blade reach you only by half, and nothing can push you out.
...Stay close.
Into the circle. As far as the lamp reaches.
The plume has returned to the sky. ...We'll meet again at the seat. Before the Pilgrim this time.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past2.fin_p: ...Hey. I thought I'd dissolved into light, and here I am in front of the tent again. Even with the rewinding stopped.

Those plume wardens charge straight at you. Take one at the cloud's edge and you go over.
The fallen plumes draw a line of light on the ground before they fire. Step out of the line.

I'll step forward and draw their eyes. When I roar, they look at me. Hit them in the back.
...Don't fall. This time I may not be able to throw you a rope.
When I roar, strike them from behind.
The herald has fallen. The real one is next. ...This time, I'll stay standing to the end.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past3.fin_p: ...One. I said I'd stop counting, and here I am counting again. This is the first time I've woken here since I dissolved into light.

Up here, time no longer turns back. If you fall, that is the end of it.
...That is why I am here.

If you fall, I will come and raise you. Wait a moment, and keep your eyes open.
But I can't do it twice in a row. Once I've raised you, stand on your own for a while.
Even if you fall, keep your eyes open. I'll come for you.
I forgot to count one. The four of us, and you. Five.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past4.fin_p: ...What a mirror reflects does not fade, it seems. Even after we returned to light before the core, this camp kept reflecting us.

This is the camp where the four of us made our promise. Once the moon was stopped, we would go beyond the sky.
...And from that sky, the Pilgrim's plume has come down.

I return the moon's light with my mirror. Stay near me and your wounds will slowly mend.
And the judgment light the plume unleashes at the last: only the Valley Self's lamp circle can keep it off. Remember that.
When the judgment light gathers, get inside the Valley Self's lamp.

You have passed the herald. The Pilgrim waits at the seat.
...We will go there too. At the end of that battle.
message.skyabyss.isle4.joined.1: The Valley Self stands with you. Inside the circle around them, foes deal half damage and cannot push you.
message.skyabyss.isle4.echo.1: In the tent, words from that last night remain.
message.skyabyss.isle4.joined.2: The Cliff Self stands with you. Now and then they step forward and roar, drawing the foes' eyes.
message.skyabyss.isle4.echo.2: In the tent, words from that last night remain.
message.skyabyss.isle4.joined.3: The Field Self stands with you. If you fall, they will come to raise you once.
message.skyabyss.isle4.echo.3: In the tent, words from that last night remain.
message.skyabyss.isle4.joined.4: The Rift Self stands with you. Near them, your wounds slowly mend.
message.skyabyss.isle4.echo.4: In the tent, words from that last night remain.
lore.skyabyss.finale.promise_echo_1.body:
By the last campfire, I trimmed the lamp's wick. Morning might not come. I trimmed it anyway.

"I'm tired of waiting in the dark," someone said.

A lamp is for those who wait. This time, it is my turn to light it.
lore.skyabyss.finale.promise_echo_2.body:
I checked the knots on my rope three times. Not for climbing. For throwing to someone who falls.

I fell many times on the cliff. Every time, it felt as if a rope came down from above. I never knew who threw it.

This time, I throw it. Even if it doesn't reach.
lore.skyabyss.finale.promise_echo_3.body:
How many times have I turned this hourglass? I didn't stop counting because the number grew too large.

I stopped because every count reminded me I was counting alone.

Tonight, four of us sit around the fire. No one slept until the last grain fell.
lore.skyabyss.finale.promise_echo_4.body:
I caught the four of us in my mirror. Valley, Cliff, Field, and me. The same face, each one different.

We made a promise. Once the moon was stopped, we would go beyond the sky. To see a morning that does not rewind.

A mirror may break, but what it reflected remains. A promise must be the same.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_promise.title: Isle of the Promise
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_promise.summa: From atop the great forge, a bridge of light runs down to an isle of moon dust.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_promise.done: The Pilgrim's plume has returned to the sky. The four have promised to come at the end of the battle at the seat.
A bridge of light runs down from the great forge to an isle the colour of moon dust. Campfire smoke and tents are visible.
Cross to the isle of the promise
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_promise.selve: The camp from the last moon. Before the four tents around the fire stand the phantoms of my former selves. Talk to them, and ask them to stand with me.
Stand with the Valley Self (south tent)
Stand with the Cliff Self (west tent)
Stand with the Field Self (east tent)
Stand with the Rift Self (north tent)
All four stand with me. The door of the moon-viewing rock to the north eases open at their presence.
Touch the door of the moon-viewing rock
Atop the moon-viewing rock, one of the Pilgrim's wings has come down: the herald plume. Use the four's arts to overcome it.
message.skyabyss.isle4.door.shut: The rock door is shut. ...You have not yet stood with all four.
message.skyabyss.isle4.taunt: The Cliff Self steps forward and roars. The foes turn to them.
message.skyabyss.isle4.raising: You are down... The Field Self is running to you. Keep your eyes open.
message.skyabyss.isle4.raised: The Field Self raised you. They cannot do it again for a while.
message.skyabyss.isle4.warden_first: The warden's charge pushed you back. ...Inside the Valley Self's circle, nothing can push you.
message.skyabyss.isle4.lord_mark: A golden ring over your head: the herald's mark. Get out of the circle. While the Cliff Self roars, the mark falls on them instead.
message.skyabyss.isle4.lord_mark_taunt: The herald's mark fell on the Cliff Self. The plume's spear cannot fell them.
message.skyabyss.isle4.lord_judge: Golden light fills the whole floor... the judgment light. Get inside the Valley Self's lamp circle.
message.skyabyss.isle4.lord_down: The Pilgrim's plume unravels into motes of light and returns to the heights. On the north rim of the rock, the platform of a bridge to the seat glows.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.title: The Pilgrim's Seat
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.summary: From atop the moon-viewing rock, a bridge of light climbs to the highest point above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.done: The chains broke and the moon became motes of light. The Pilgrim withdrew, and the seat stands empty.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.walk.jou: From the north rim of the moon-viewing rock, a bridge of light climbs upward. At its end is a seat above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.walk.arr: Climb the bridge to the Pilgrim's seat
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.throne.j: A ring of bell cloud surrounds the white floor. On the northern dais stands a great, empty seat.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.throne.t: Touch the seat on the northern dais
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.lord.jou: The Pilgrim has come down, though never in full. Hands, an eye, and the moon it drags behind it. Everything learned on the isles is needed here.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_seat.lord.lor: Drive back the Pilgrim above the clouds
message.skyabyss.seat.form1: The clouds beyond the ring swell, and two great hands reach up... the Pilgrim. The ring's cloud hardens when the corner bells ring.
message.skyabyss.seat.form2: The hands sink beneath the clouds... The sky splits, and a great eye looks down on the seat. The ring stays firm. Hide behind the pillars from its beams and stare.
message.skyabyss.seat.form3: The eye closes. From above the clouds, a moon bound in chains is dragged close. Time falters... and at the four sides of the seat, my former selves stand.
message.skyabyss.seat.hand_stuck: The hand stays planted on the floor... strike it now.
message.skyabyss.seat.hand_scrape: The hand clawed the ring of cloud and the bells' hold came undone... ring them again.
message.skyabyss.seat.eye_stare: The eye is fixed on you... get behind a pillar.
message.skyabyss.seat.moon_pull: The moon is pulling the seat toward it. Walk outward to hold your ground. Inside the Valley Self's circle, it cannot pull you.
message.skyabyss.seat.moon_fall: The moon's shadow spreads across the floor... it is falling. Get inside the Valley Self's lamp circle.
message.skyabyss.seat.down: The chains snap and the moon shatters into motes of light. The Pilgrim's presence above the clouds recedes... and the seat stands empty.
message.skyabyss.seat.throne_shut: The seat is cold. ...You are still on the way here.
message.skyabyss.seat.throne_busy: The Pilgrim has already descended upon the seat.
area.skyabyss.finale_seat.sub: The highest place above the clouds
subtitles.skyabyss_finale.hand_rise: Great hands rise from the clouds
message.skyabyss.ending.choose: Standing before the seat, the storyteller's seventh verse rings in your ears: "Open the seventh eye, and choose of two." ...Choose.
message.skyabyss.ending.rechoose: The seat still waits for a choice. You may choose again.
message.skyabyss.ending.option.calm.hint: Heal the heart and restore the pull between sky and earth. The moon draws away and the titans sing again.
message.skyabyss.ending.option.break.hin: Break the heart and seal the Pilgrim away. A crack remains in the sky, and the titans sleep deeply.
message.skyabyss.ending.option.accept.hi: Invite the Pilgrim down to the earth. A wing circles the daytime sky, and the bell that watched the sky falls silent.
message.skyabyss.ending.calm.title: Soothe
message.skyabyss.ending.calm.sub: The pull between sky and earth returns
message.skyabyss.ending.break.title: Break
message.skyabyss.ending.break.sub: The sky is cracked, and the Pilgrim sealed away
message.skyabyss.ending.accept.title: Accept
message.skyabyss.ending.accept.sub: The Pilgrim circles the sky above the earth
message.skyabyss.ending.calm.after: Back on the ground, a distant moon, a clear sky and the titans' song await. Touch the seat to choose again.
message.skyabyss.ending.break.after: Back on the ground, the sky is cracked. The titans sleep deeply, but their backs can still be climbed. Touch the seat to choose again.
message.skyabyss.ending.accept.after: Back on the ground, the Pilgrim's wing circles the daytime sky. The city's bell rings no more. Touch the seat to choose again.
chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.finale: The promise between sky and earth has been chosen.
chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.finale.calm: The moon draws away, and the titans sing once more.
chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.finale.break: Beneath the cracked sky, the world goes on, changed.
chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.finale.accept: A wing circles the daytime sky. No one watches it anymore.
lore.skyabyss.finale.ending_calm.title: The Soothing Morning
lore.skyabyss.finale.ending_calm.body:
When you laid your hand on the seat, light descended to the heart in the depths. The loosened beat fell back into step, and sky and earth drew on one another again.

The Pilgrim withdrew. Not gone: only returned to the heights, as one half of the pull.

The titans are singing. The moon is far. ...Should the anchor ever loosen again, surely someone will ring the bell.
lore.skyabyss.finale.ending_break.title: The Cracked Sky
lore.skyabyss.finale.ending_break.body:
You cut the chains and shattered the heart. The pull between sky and earth came undone. The Pilgrim is sealed beyond the crack in the sky, and will drag the moon no more.

The titans no longer sing. Their deep sleep will not rewind.

The crack will not close. But beneath it, people light their lamps. The world you chose belongs to the one who chose it.
lore.skyabyss.finale.ending_accept.title: The Pilgrim Invited
lore.skyabyss.finale.ending_accept.body:
All my former selves stopped at the same place. They saw the Pilgrim as an enemy, never as the other half of the pull.

You left the seat empty and invited the Pilgrim down to the earth. The moon was freed of its chains, and a wing circles the daytime sky. The bell that watched the sky is needed no longer.

The watchers no longer only watch. My former selves rode the wing, past the promise.
item.skyabyss.divine_sky_sword.desc: A white greatsword with a folded-wing guard. Every fourth blow, a hand of light strikes the foe (×0.6 attack, nearby too).
item.skyabyss.divine_bell_hammer.desc: Its head is a great golden bell laid on its side. Every third blow it rings, dealing ×0.3 attack to nearby foes and slowing them.
item.skyabyss.divine_dawn_staff.desc: A staff whose lantern cage holds an eye of dawn. Strikes light the foe for 4 s (lit foes take +12% from everyone).
item.skyabyss.divine_plume_bow.desc: Its limbs are the Pilgrim's white flight feathers. When an arrow hits, three feathers fall a moment later (30% of the hit each).
item.skyabyss.divine_rewind_dagger.desc: A blade of black glass with a broken-gear guard. 1.5 s after a strike, the same foe is struck again (35%).
A white crescent with four lights and bells. Each strike grants nearby allies the promise's guard for 3 s (×0.85 damage taken).
item.skyabyss.cloud_heart.desc: The seventh heart core, won at the Pilgrim's seat. Use while sneaking to break it into 5 heart core shards.
item.skyabyss.heart_core_shard.desc: Fuel for strengthening divine relics (resonance forge). Any of the seven heart cores breaks into 5 shards when used while sneaking.
legend.skyabyss.divine_sky_hand.effect: 0.6 s after the cleave, a hand of light slams down ahead (×0.8 attack within 3, lifts foes).
legend.skyabyss.divine_bell_wave.effect: A triple wave of bell-sound spreads from the blow (up to radius 6, ×0.5 attack and 2 s slow).
legend.skyabyss.divine_dawn_gaze.effect: Where it lands, a beam of light turns for 2 s, burning foes inside it (×0.18 spell power each).
legend.skyabyss.divine_plume_rain.effect: A moment later, feathers fall along the line of the shot (8 spots, ×0.3 attack).
legend.skyabyss.divine_rewind_lunge.effe: 1 s later, an afterimage runs the same path again (×0.6 attack to foes along it).
legend.skyabyss.divine_promise_circle.ef: Leaves a shield circle of radius 4 for 6 s where you sang. Allies inside take ×0.6 damage.
message.skyabyss.divine.given: Received a divine relic: %s. Change your job at the Hall of Callings and it becomes that job's relic.
message.skyabyss.divine.swapped: Your divine relic took the shape of your new job: %s
message.skyabyss.divine.core_broken: You broke the heart core. Heart core shards ×%s
message.skyabyss.trial.calendar: The sundial of the cloud calendar marks the Pilgrim's shadow. Tiers cleared: %s
message.skyabyss.trial.option.hint.5: Health ×1.75, damage ×1.4, faster moves, and each form is layered (three slam circles, half the eye's opening, rewinds thrice)
message.skyabyss.trial.begin: The Pilgrim's Trial, tier %s. The Pilgrim descends once more.
message.skyabyss.trial.keepsake: For a moment, the sundial's shadow stood still. ...It has been written in your lore.
message.skyabyss.trial.shut: The sundial's shadow does not move. ...You have not yet driven back the Pilgrim.
lore.skyabyss.finale.keepsake_pilgrim.bo:
When you cleared the fifth tier, the shadow on the cloud calendar's sundial stood still, just once.

The Pilgrim descends again and again. Driven back, it returns as the other half of the pull. Not because it is an enemy. It is testing whether anyone still stands on this side of the world.

The shadow moves again. The next pilgrimage is coming.
item.skyabyss.founder_shawl.desc: Looks only. Right-click to wear or take off. Changes no stats
item.skyabyss.founder_shawl.story: "You don't learn where the stars are with your eyes. You learn it with your shoulders."
item.skyabyss.founder_handbell.desc: Right-click for one clear toll. Ring it in the capital and the great bell tower answers
item.skyabyss.founder_handbell.story: "Ring it, and someone answers. That is what a bell is."
message.skyabyss.founder.appear: Someone stands inside the bell. Cloth binds their eyes, and on the cloth an open eye is painted.
message.skyabyss.founder.phase2: First Skywatcher: "I can still hear you."
message.skyabyss.founder.phase3: First Skywatcher: "Open your eyes. Choose of two."
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.listen: Strike while she listens and she strikes back. Wait, and she leaves a wide opening.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.shadow: Watch where the shadow band comes from and step out sideways.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.crouch: "Lie down." Crouch and the pole's ring passes over your head.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.lookup: Your upturned eyes were burned. Don't follow her with your eyes; look ahead.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.moon: Get out of the moon circle. Where it lands, your feet grow heavy for a while.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.pulse: Jump with the floor's heartbeat and it won't take your feet.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.lid: Outside the lid of light burns. Get inside, close to her.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.split: She became two. The real one's hip bell rings whenever she moves.
message.skyabyss.founder.tell.echo: Only an echo. The one whose bell rings is real.
message.skyabyss.founder.end2: First Skywatcher: "To one who has seen all three endings, I give the last line. ...Eight: you may rest now."
message.skyabyss.founder.end3: The song melted into the toll. The inside of the bell fell quiet.
message.skyabyss.founder.fell: You nearly fell through the bell's mouth and were pulled back to the floor.
message.skyabyss.founder.woke: You woke beside the gate of the great bell tower. Inside the bell, someone is still singing.
message.skyabyss.founder.shawl_on: You put on the Skywatcher's Shawl.
message.skyabyss.founder.shawl_off: You took off the Skywatcher's Shawl.
message.skyabyss.founder.won.title: The Eighth Verse
message.skyabyss.founder.again.title: The bell is quiet again
quest.skyabyss.side_founder.title: The Eighth Verse
quest.skyabyss.side_founder.summary: You have seen all three endings. The storyteller says the counting song goes on.
quest.skyabyss.side_founder.done: The song inside the bell is over. The skywatchers' watch is lifted.
quest.skyabyss.side_founder.verse.journa: Calm, break, accept: you have seen every ending. Ask the storyteller how the counting song goes on.
quest.skyabyss.side_founder.enter.journa: The eighth verse is said to be inside the bell. Touch the gate of the great bell tower and choose [Inside the bell].
quest.skyabyss.side_founder.founder.jour: Inside the bell, the First Skywatcher is singing. Pass the seven lessons and hear the last line.
quest.skyabyss.side_founder.tell.journal: You heard the eighth verse. Tell the storyteller.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.founder_ve:
...You've seen all three, haven't you. Calmed it, broke it, let it in.
It's in your face. Which was right, I can't tell you.

I always thought the seventh was the last verse. But grandmother told me this:
"The eighth is inside the bell. A bellkeeper can only sing outside it."

Touch the gate of the great bell tower. Someone is still singing inside the bell.
...My ears have heard it all along.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.founder_af: The bell has gone quiet. ...You heard the eighth verse.

"Eight: you may rest now."
Now I know why grandmother never sang it. Sing it, and the watch is over.

The skywatchers don't need to watch the sky any more. ...Maybe I can sleep a little too.
Thank you, one who stays.
lore.skyabyss.finale.founder.title: The First Skywatcher
lore.skyabyss.finale.founder.body:
The one inside the bell was the first of the skywatchers.

When the pilgrim's shadow first crossed the sky, she looked up and kept a ledger, cast the great bell, and taught the children a counting song. A shadow by day, lying down, not looking up, the moon at night. The song was a lesson in staying alive.

She looked up too long and lost her eyes. Each time the moon fell, the song and the ledger vanished. So she bound her own voice into the bell's toll. Only the toll outlasts the rewinding.

That someone must always keep watch: that was the bell's binding. The skywatchers gave their lives to it, grew fewer, and died out.
lore.skyabyss.finale.eighth_verse.title: The Eighth Verse
lore.skyabyss.finale.eighth_verse.inscri:
One: a shadow comes by day
Two: lie down with the sheep
Three: do not look up
Four: at night the moon comes
Five: the deep earth breathes
Six: the round lid of the sky
Seven: open your eyes and choose of two
Eight: you may rest now
lore.skyabyss.finale.eighth_verse.body:
The last line, which even grandmother never sang.

It cannot be sung outside the bell. It is handed, inside the bell, only to one who has seen all three endings.

It is the song that lifts the watch. No one needs to watch the sky any more.

item.skyabyss.divine_bellkeeper.desc: Heavy set. 4 pieces: damage taken x0.92; when hurt, a bell rings and pushes back foes within 4 (once per 8s)
item.skyabyss.divine_mistwalker.desc: Light set. 4 pieces: +10% speed; when hurt, vanish into mist for 1s (once per 10s)
item.skyabyss.divine_lampkeeper.desc: Arcane set. 4 pieces: +35% mana regeneration; using a skill gives allies within 6 damage taken x0.92 for 4s
item.skyabyss.divine_warden_blade.desc: A broad blade scaled with white plumes. When hurt: your next hit within 3s deals +40%.
item.skyabyss.divine_warden_blade.story: "A warden without a shield took the blow on its plumes."
item.skyabyss.divine_ash_hammer.desc: A hammer with a forge-isle anvil for a head. Hit foes melt for 3s (+10% damage taken from anyone).
item.skyabyss.divine_ash_hammer.story: "Under cold ash, the fire still waits to be struck."
item.skyabyss.divine_eyelid_staff.desc: A one-eyed staff under cloud eyelids. Hits tie a gaze thread for 3s; if the foe moves 6 away, a pillar of light strikes (80% of attack).
item.skyabyss.divine_eyelid_staff.story: "Even with the lids closed, the eye watches."
item.skyabyss.divine_mist_bow.desc: A bow of mistbird wings. Hits leave mist for 3s (foes inside are slowed and take +10%).
item.skyabyss.divine_mist_bow.story: "In the mist, only the bird knows the way."
item.skyabyss.divine_moth_dagger.desc: A dagger of twin moth wings. Hits dust foes with light (5s, they glow); a backstab on a dusted foe deals x1.5.
item.skyabyss.divine_moth_dagger.story: "Those drawn to the lamp are judged by it."
item.skyabyss.divine_keeper_bell_staff.d: A staff crowned with a tiny belfry. Every 4th hit rings a bell: foes within 5 slowed for 2s, allies within 5 (and you) heal 2.
item.skyabyss.divine_keeper_bell_staff.s: "The last bellkeeper kept ringing to the very end."
item.skyabyss.divine_plume_charm.desc: A white flight feather on a gold quill. No fall damage. +8% damage while airborne.
item.skyabyss.divine_plume_charm.story: "When the pilgrim fell, the feather caught them."
item.skyabyss.divine_promise_chime.desc: A small gold bell with four lights. Revive allies x1.5 faster; revived allies take x0.7 damage for 3s.
item.skyabyss.divine_promise_chime.story: "Ring it, and your former selves lend a hand."
